edges.reason: Deposit uses msg.sender as the depositor identity for the whole flow.
depositAndOrder requires msg.sender == userAddress before depositing.
createOrder requires msg.sender == userAddress before spending deposits.
borrowOrder verifies eligibility for userAddress but creates the order for msg.sender, permitting callers to borrow against other accounts.
Borrow requires userAddress == msg.sender before withdrawing funds.
changeOwner checks msg.sender == owner.
updateContracts checks msg.sender == owner before swapping implementation addresses.
cancelOrder checks msg.sender == creator of the order.
Withdraw uses msg.sender as the withdrawing account.
wERC20.mint requires MINTER_ROLE for _msgSender.
changeAdmin requires ETMOWNER_ROLE and re-grants admin, minter and pauser roles.
wERC20.lock requires MINTER_ROLE.
wERC20.release requires MINTER_ROLE.
orderExpired can be triggered by anyone once block.timestamp passes expiryDate.
dueCheck gates locking and ECO minting purely on now versus the scheduled due time.
calculateECOEarning computes (time - now) with the stored deposit time, so raw subtraction underflows and the reward math is unusable.
_ordersub derives the order id from keccak256 including block.timestamp.
freePusher stores time: now inside the freeStorage struct.
matchOrder sets time: now and expiryDate: now + duration * 30 days.
freePusher is guarded only by Init.friendlyaddress(msg.sender).
freePopper guard uses the friendlyaddress mapping.
newOrder guard uses the friendlyaddress mapping.
cancelOrder guard uses the friendlyaddress mapping.
setOwnerFeeVault only checks friendlyaddress before mutating the fee vault.
setFriendlyAddress discards the owner comparison result because require is missing, letting anyone self-grant friendly status.
freePusher writes deposit and borrow bookkeeping into users.
freePopper reads and mutates users deposits and borrows.
getbuyPower reads totalDeposit and totalBorrowed from users.
getECOEarnings iterates users deposits and borrows.
poolSorter reads yields from openOrderMap while sorting.
poolSorter rebuilds the per-token orderpool array.
poolSorter writes the rebuilt array back into orderpool.
matchOrder writes the matchedOrder record.
matchOrder reads and updates the order status.
newOrder reads poolindex to choose the matching counterparty.
newOrder reads counterparty amount and yield from openOrderMap.
pushOrder obtains the order id, net amount and fee from _ordersub.
pushOrder writes the new Order into openOrderMap.
orderMonthlyDue reads amount, yield and token from matchOrderMap.
orderMonthlyDue multiplies yield, duration and oracle price without SafeMath, risking overflow on large values.
fetchTokenPrice queries the Abacus oracle through the stored reference.
USDValue consumes the price returned by fetchTokenPrice.
matchOrder performs an external mintWrappedToken call into EcoMoneyManager mid-flow.
orderExpired calls EMM.releaseWrappedToken before finishing per-user state cleanup.
payDue calls the external EMM.burnECOFrom during due accounting.
dueCheck calls the external EMM.mintECO after timestamp-based checks.
scheduleExpiry forwards value into the oracle payable scheduleFunc call.
scheduleCheck forwards value into the oracle payable scheduleFunc call.
The Abacus oracle later calls back orderExpired with an externally chosen orderId.
The Abacus oracle later calls back dueCheck to drive lock and mint logic.
DepositManager pulls deposited ERC20 tokens with an external transferFrom.
WithdrawManager transfers native ETH to a caller supplied address.
redeemEcoEarning moves wrapped ECO out of the money manager using an external token call.
sendValue performs a full-gas low level call that can re-enter the caller contract.
_functionCallWithValue performs a full-gas low level call to an arbitrary target.
releaseWrappedToken calls wERC20.release which decrements lockedAmount.
mintWrappedToken calls wERC20.mint which increases supply and balance.
lockWrappedToken calls wERC20.lock which increases lockedAmount.
burnWrappedFrom calls wERC20.burnFrom which decreases balance and supply.
wERC20.release delegates to ERC20._release.
wERC20.lock delegates to ERC20._lock.
wERC20.burnFrom delegates to ERC20._burn.
_transfer mutates the _balances ledger.
_transfer enforces the lockedAmount constraint through availableAmount.
_mint increases the total supply.
_burn decreases the total supply.
createWrapToken registers the new wrapped token configuration and fetch id.
changeOwner is gated by the stored owner state variable.
EcoceliumInit.changeOwner is gated by the owner state variable.
Ecocelium.changeOwner is gated by the owner state variable.
cancelOrder consults Init for the friendlyaddress guard.
dueCheck exempts registrar accounts read from EcoceliumInit.
dueCheck reads and writes isUserLocked to gate borrower penalties.
_ordersub computes the trade fee with raw multiplication and division by 100.
isWithdrawEligible applies CDSpercent to buy power.
calculateECOEarning multiplies slabRateDeposit by the ECO amount without SafeMath.
getECOEarnings subtracts previously withdrawn ECO amounts.

Accumulator returned by freePopper and forwarded to the fee vault.

Yield compared against the pool inside newOrder.
Duration compared and propagated by newOrder.
Counterparty snapshot used only for comparisons inside newOrder.
Pool cursor consumed by the newOrder matching loop.
Rebuilt array variable that poolSorter writes back to orderpool.
Externally supplied id that drives the release path in orderExpired.
Delay argument built only to call the oracle from scheduleExpiry.
Encoded calldata built solely for the scheduleExpiry oracle call.
Value forwarded with the payable oracle call made by scheduleExpiry.
Return value computed by the USDValue helper.

Final reward returned by calculateECOEarning.
